blocks.title: How long does customs clearance take in Kenya?
blocks.body: Customs clearance in Kenya can move faster when documents are complete, duties are paid on time and no inspection or agency query arises. In practice, many import shipments need one to four working days depending on cargo type, KRA review, KEBS or other agency requirements, payment timing and port, ICD or airport workflows.
paragraphs: Kenya Tradex reduces avoidable delays by checking the bill of lading or airway bill, commercial invoice, packing list, HS code exposure, permits and release requirements before the file becomes urgent.
